reason: My Excel works and I know every row of it. $89 a month is more than a tenth of what I earn in a year, for something that makes me move everything and retrain people.
objection: I would have to move all my clients and retrain my staff, and only 1 to 5 companies pay for it and there are no references. If it breaks, my clients and debts are stuck in someone else's system.
would_change_my_mind: A friend who runs a similar business using it for months and telling me it saved him money, plus someone from Nexio importing my Excel for free and a price near $20 a month.
